{{Quote|Or Count Dojarat of Prospera Jang, the gentleman adventurer who lets his marks go free if they beat him at boxing.|Arack Dostryt mentions Dojarat in his section of the Bounty Hunter Code|<ref name="The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett">''[[The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett]]''</ref>}}
'''Dojarat''' was an [[Ualaq/Legends|Ualaq]] [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Count/Legends|count]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Prospera Jang]] who served the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Bounty Hunters' Guild]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. When pursuing [[Bounty/Legends|bounties]], Dojarat would allow his targets to go free if they successfully beat him in a bout of [[Unarmed combat/Legends|boxing]]. Due to this trait he was written about by fellow bounty hunter [[Arack Dostryt]] in ''[[The Bounty Hunter Code]]'', the Guild member's [[Book/Legends|handbook]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|In the Guild, odd-balls are the norm, not the exception.|Dostryt listed the count as one of several odd members of the guild|<ref name="The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett" />}}
The [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Ualaq/Legends|Ualaq]] [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] named Dojarat held the title of [[Count/Legends|count]] and membership of the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Bounty Hunters' Guild]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett" /> From the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Prospera Jang]], the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] became well known for the quirk of letting any [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] go if they could beat him at [[Unarmed combat/Legends|boxing]], and lost bounties because of it. The Bounty Hunters' Guild's director of recruiting, [[Arack Dostryt]], mentioned Dojarat in his section of the Guild member's handbook, ''[[The Bounty Hunter Code]]'', which was titled "Becoming a Bounty Hunter" and included the count in a section on "Quirks" that hunters might have.<ref name="The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|The Ualaq from Prospera Jang has a devastating left.|Dostryt mentions Dojarat's boxing ability|<ref name="The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett" />}}
Dojarat earned a reputation as a gentleman adventurer during his career as a bounty hunter, and became known for the odd quirk of challenging every acquisition he captured to a round of boxing. Any individual who could beat the count he would let go; however, according to Dostryt, the Aqualish had a powerful left blow when fighting. Dojarat had [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and gray skin. His largest right eye was replaced at some point by a [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] implant.<ref name="The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett" />

==Behind the scenes==
Dojarat was first mentioned and pictured in [[2014]] in ''[[The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett]]'', a reference book written by [[Jason Fry]], [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Ryder Windham]].
